thread:
Maria V: Heads-up — saw some odd quota attribution in staging. Requests routed through proxy A are showing up as 'origin-less' in billing logs. Anyone else?
Ajay Patel: yup, noticed it after the proxy routing rule B rollout. ~12% of traces missing attribution key.
Sam K: do you have a sample trace id? could be header stripping at the auth-proxy layer.
Maria V: trace stg-20260318-15:12:03 id=stg-9f2a. snippet below — looks fine at client side though:
Maria V: ```
GET /v1/generate
Host: api.staging.redwood.dev
X-Auth-Claim: org=acme;project=payments;sa=invoice-worker
X-Forwarded-For: 10.0.0.5
```
Ajay Patel: gateway rewrites `X-Auth-Claim` -> `X-Auth` for routing. our new strip-header rule for 307/308 redirects is dropping `X-Auth` in some preflight paths.
Priya R: that matches a theory — redirect proxy path doesn't preserve custom headers for cross-zone hops. We should consider extracting claims from the signed JWT as a more robust source.
Sam K: parsing JWTs in the gateway is doable but increases CPU on the critical path. we need telemetry first to prove it's worth it.
Maria V: agree on telemetry. also console wiring: if we change extraction, historical dashboards might lose attribution unless we backfill. UX note: users will see a gap in per-project cost unless we map old headers.
Priya R: rollout suggestion: canary 5% region, add a metric `auth.claim.missing` + trace tag to identify flows. create a dashboard panel and an alert (warn at >1%).
console-bot: :information_source: metric created `auth.claim.missing` (staging). runbook template: https://go/internal/runbooks/auth-claim-missing
Ajay Patel: also proposal for quota fallback order: 1) explicit claim header (X-Auth-Claim/X-Auth), 2) JWT claim extraction (if signed), 3) origin->project mapping table. Document for console so billing + quota use same order.
Sam K: +1. we should also add a short-lived backfill job that queries ingress logs and patches missing attribution for the last 48h before cutover.
Maria V: I'll open the gateway PR for opt-in JWT extraction + the backfill job PR, and I'll add the dashboard card + alert in the console PR.
Priya R: FYI: watch edge case where impersonation proxies set `sa=` differently. telemetry should tag `claim.source` (header/jwt/backfill) so we can audit differences.
Maria V: good call — add `claim.source` to traces. thanks everyone, I'll post the rollout plan once PRs land :thumbsup:
